target.style: high-fidelity fantasy MMORPG with Ragnarok-inspired proportions and readable stylization; not photorealistic and not low-poly placeholder art
target.camera: three-quarter/isometric-friendly camera with strong depth, readable silhouettes and layered foreground/midground/background
target.lighting: bright daylight baseline, soft directional shadows, subtle ambient occlusion, controlled bloom, rich but coherent material response
target.characters: full-body production models, expressive face/hair, layered clothing/armor, distinct class silhouettes, meaningful tier progression
target.environment: dense authored architecture, varied roofs/walls, paving variation, props, vegetation, landmarks, water and social-space details
target.materials: PBR-ready albedo, roughness, metallic and normal maps; avoid flat single-color materials

references.purpose: bright stone plaza, banners, fountain, medieval town composition
market props, paving, umbrellas, vegetation, lived-in environment
character density, social hub composition, readable silhouettes
